en: Native listen address; Docker keeps 0.0.0.0 inside the container.
zh: 原生监听地址；Docker 容器内部保持 0.0.0.0。

en: Native HTTP port; Docker keeps 8080 and changes the published host port.
zh: 原生 HTTP 端口；Docker 保持内部 8080，修改宿主端口映射。

en: Database URL created during setup. Changing database products requires a migration plan.
zh: 初始化生成的数据库地址；更换数据库产品必须另行迁移。

en: Database account; not used for SQLite. Never put credentials in a URL.
zh: 数据库账号，SQLite 不使用；不要将凭据写入连接地址。

en: Edit only in the private application.properties; never pass on the command line.
zh: 仅在受限 application.properties 内修改，不通过命令行传递。

en: Connection pool size; coordinate with the database connection budget.
zh: 连接池大小，应与数据库可承受连接数一起规划。

en: Global schedule scanner; individual schedules still need to be enabled in the UI.
zh: 全局调度扫描开关；具体调度仍需在页面启用。

en: Enable ETL tasks.
zh: 启用 ETL 任务。

en: Enable batch ETL tasks.
zh: 启用批量 ETL 任务。

en: Enable trusted Local JAR plugins only after preparing their directory and dependencies.
zh: 准备好目录和依赖后，按需启用可信 Local JAR 插件。

en: Absolute plugin directory on the executing node; Docker requires an explicit mount.
zh: 执行节点的插件绝对目录；Docker 需要显式挂载。

en: Comma-separated absolute roots allowed for browsing LOCAL resource drafts.
zh: 允许浏览 LOCAL 资源草稿的绝对根目录，多个目录用逗号分隔。

en: Connection timeout for the shared HTTP client, not every external plugin.
zh: 共用 HTTP 客户端连接超时，不代表所有外部插件的超时。

en: Read timeout for the shared HTTP client.
zh: 共用 HTTP 客户端读取超时。

en: Default notification language; notification-specific choices can override it.
zh: 通知默认语言，可被具体通知配置覆盖。

en: Enable event ingress; authentication and EVENT_PUBLISH permission still apply.
zh: 启用事件接入；仍要求登录和 EVENT_PUBLISH 权限。

en: Enable history retention only after reviewing the retention rules.
zh: 核对保留规则后再启用历史清理。

en: Keep true for a dry run; false permits deletion when retention is enabled.
zh: 保持 true 时只演练；清理开启且为 false 时允许删除。

en: Native log rotation size; Docker logging is configured in Compose.
zh: 原生日志单文件滚动大小；Docker 日志在 Compose 中配置。

en: Native log archive retention in days.
zh: 原生日志归档保留天数。

en: Native archive size cap; may remove archives before the day limit.
zh: 原生日志归档总容量上限，可能提前清理未到期归档。

en: Server fallback locale; Accept-Language and frontend preference also apply.
zh: 服务端缺省语言；Accept-Language 和前端偏好另有作用。

en: Internal scheduled-scanner threads; not the maximum business-task concurrency.
zh: 内部周期扫描线程数量；不是业务任务最大并发数。

en: Node identity; use distinct names in a cluster for traceability.
zh: 节点标识；集群各节点取不同名称，便于追踪运行。

en: API/SCHEDULER/WORKER/MAINTENANCE responsibilities; retain coverage of required roles.
zh: API/SCHEDULER/WORKER/MAINTENANCE 职责；部署前确保所需角色仍有人承担。

en: Worker groups match published definitions; empty worker groups do not mean all groups.
zh: 节点执行分组；与发布定义的分组匹配，空节点分组并不表示能接所有分组。

en: Task IDs eligible as root trigger targets; jointly restrict scope with the job allowlist.
zh: 允许领取的根触发目标任务 ID；与作业白名单共同限制范围，见组合规则。

en: Job IDs eligible as root trigger targets; not an individual authorization list for every descendant task.
zh: 允许领取的根触发目标作业 ID；不等价于对子作业内每个任务逐一授权。

en: In-flight root-run limit per node; size with executors, concurrency controls and capacity.
zh: 节点在途根运行上限；结合线程池、任务并发和资源容量评估。

en: Default scheduling time zone; distinct from display time zone. Check individual schedules.
zh: 调度默认业务时区；与用户显示时区不同，核验单条调度设置。

en: Default missed-fire policy SKIP/FIRE_ONCE/CATCH_UP_BOUNDED; may create real catch-up runs.
zh: 错过触发默认策略 SKIP/FIRE_ONCE/CATCH_UP_BOUNDED；可能产生实际补发。

en: Grace period for missed fires; verify alongside catch-up policy.
zh: 判断错过触发的宽限时间；联动补发策略验证。

en: Maximum catch-up lookback; bounds recovery bursts.
zh: 补发回溯时间上限；避免恢复后集中补发过多历史运行。

en: Maximum catch-up count; applies with the lookback window.
zh: 补发次数上限；与时间窗口共同约束。

en: History cleanup: Run interval. Validate against load, recovery or cleanup policy before tuning.
zh: 历史清理：运行间隔。结合负载、恢复或清理策略验证后调整。

en: History cleanup: Batch size. Validate against load, recovery or cleanup policy before tuning.
zh: 历史清理：批次大小。结合负载、恢复或清理策略验证后调整。

en: History cleanup: Maximum batches per run. Validate against load, recovery or cleanup policy before tuning.
zh: 历史清理：单轮最大批次数。结合负载、恢复或清理策略验证后调整。

en: Execution history retention duration; applies with cleanup enabled and dry-run settings.
zh: 执行历史保留时长；与清理总开关和试运行共同生效。

en: Notification history retention duration; applies with cleanup enabled and dry-run settings.
zh: 通知历史保留时长；与清理总开关和试运行共同生效。

en: Event history retention duration; applies with cleanup enabled and dry-run settings.
zh: 事件历史保留时长；与清理总开关和试运行共同生效。

en: Node-run history retention duration; applies with cleanup enabled and dry-run settings.
zh: 节点运行历史保留时长；与清理总开关和试运行共同生效。

en: Audit history retention duration; applies with cleanup enabled and dry-run settings.
zh: 审计历史保留时长；与清理总开关和试运行共同生效。

en: Executor shutdown wait; coordinate with container grace and Spring shutdown limits.
zh: 执行器关闭等待；与容器停止宽限和 Spring 关闭时限一起规划。

en: event plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: event 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: script plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: script 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: sql plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: sql 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: file-transfer plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: file-transfer 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: api-call plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: api-call 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: push plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: push 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: data-check plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: data-check 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: server-monitor plugin switch on this node; review published tasks and active work before disabling.
zh: server-monitor 插件节点级开关；关闭前检查已发布任务和运行中工作。

en: Total session token lifetime in seconds; tune to session policy.
zh: 登录令牌总有效期，单位秒；按会话策略调整。

en: Idle session timeout in seconds; distinct from total lifetime.
zh: 空闲会话超时，单位秒；区别于总有效期。

en: Email channel implementation switch, enabled when absent; SMTP and credentials belong in mail-channel UI.
zh: 邮件通道实现开关，缺省也启用；SMTP 连接与凭据在邮件通道页面维护。
